lines: Six half essence true śāstra to be accepted this clearly; by thirty-six by principle force born; although infinite world chain this Brahmāṇḍa very delightful but without variety not indeed delightful state.
l4.sanskrit_cite: ṣaḍardhasāraṃ sacchāstramupādeyamidaṃ sphuṭam ṣaṭtriṃśatā tattvabalena sūtā yadyapyanantā bhuvanāvalīyam brahmāṇḍamatyantamanoharaṃ tu vaicitryavarjaṃ nahi ramyabhāvaḥ
